valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E. KLA's fiscal year ends June, so at the Nov 2027 12-month target date an investor prices FY2028 (July 2027 to June 2028) non-GAAP diluted EPS, the same convention as LRCX. Anchored on the Q1 FY2027 print (reported Oct 28, 2026 after the close): revenue $4.136B, non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.22, non-GAAP net income $1.603B, diluted shares 1,311.1M. Q2 FY2027 guide (December quarter): revenue $4.7B +/- $0.2B, non-GAAP EPS $1.44 +/- $0.11, 1,306M shares, non-GAAP gross margin 62.5%. Model: FY2028 revenue x non-GAAP net margin / ~1.306B diluted shares. Non-GAAP net margin was 38.8% in Q1 and about 40% implied by Q2 guidance. Base case assumes FY2028 revenue about $21.0B (about +12% on an FY2027 run-rate of about $18.7B built from Q1, the Q2 guide, and assumed H2 revenue of $4.9B and $5.0B) at a 40% net margin. Interest, other income and the net-cash position are ignored; price-only targets with dividends shown separately. The FY2027 quarterly path beyond Q2 and the FY2028 figures are model assumptions, not company guidance; no sourced FY2028 consensus was found.

bear.driver: Wafer-fab-equipment down-cycle and China digestion: FY2028 revenue about $18.0B (flat on the FY2027 run-rate), net margin falling to 36%
bear.assumption: EPS $4.95 at 21x (trough-cycle multiple for a company with a 40%+ margin history)

base.driver: Guide-based growth continues: FY2028 revenue about $21.0B (+12%), net margin 40% in line with the Q2 guide, shares 1.306B

bull.driver: AI packaging and leading-edge logic capex upcycle: FY2028 revenue about $23.5B, net margin 42%

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $6.40 the 152.32 close implies 23.8x. The MarketBeat consensus target of $220.35 (Oct-Nov 2026, not individually dated here) implies 34.4x at base EPS, or about $8.80 EPS at a constant 25x (about 37% above the model).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.40 (about 4.2 pp of return); $0.10 of FY2028 EPS moves it by $2.50 (about 1.6 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Quarterly revenue vs the $4.7B +/- $0.2B December-quarter guide, and the non-GAAP operating or net margin vs the 62.5% gross margin guide (net margin about 40%).
valuation.next_disclosure: Fiscal Q2 2027 (December quarter) earnings, expected late January 2027 (date not confirmed in sources)

analyst_notes: No named analyst calls from the last 12 months could be verified from accessible sources, so the events list is empty and the coverage is labelled unavailable. Firm-level actions after the Oct 28 print, reported by MarketBeat on Oct 30, were: Morgan Stanley overweight reaffirmed at $220; Susquehanna cut $215 to $190 (neutral); Wells Fargo cut $245 to $210 (overweight); JPMorgan raised $238 to $240 (overweight); Stifel buy at $230; Citigroup trimmed to $275 (buy); Argus buy at $225. These have no named analyst and are not used in any weighted target. The MarketBeat consensus of about $220 sits roughly 37% above the $160 base case, which needs about $8.80 EPS at 25x or a multiple near 34x on base EPS. Prices and consensus in these sources were not all on one date or one basis, and some results carried pre-split (10-for-1, June 2026) targets, which were excluded.
